findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_state_rules, get_rule, get_ad_filing_requirements, search_ethics_opinions · Private data: list_datasets, cite, get_ad_filing_requirements, get_attorney_fee_caps, search_ethics_opinions, data_lookup, data_compare, data_search · Public sink: get_ad_filing_requirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_state_rules, get_rule, get_ad_filing_requirements, search_ethics_opinions · Private data: list_datasets, cite, get_ad_filing_requirements, get_attorney_fee_caps, search_ethics_opinions, data_lookup, data_compare, data_search · Public sink: get_ad_filing_requirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
